name: craft-gtm
description: 8 strategic GTM execution tools: PMF Assessment, Launch Planning, Customer Research, Retention Playbooks, Partner Programs, Crisis Response, Competitive Intelligence, and Strategy Analyzer.
long_description: Built on the CRAFT framework (Character, Result, Artifact, Frame, Timeline), this MCP server provides comprehensive go-to-market strategy tools for founders, CMOs, and strategy leaders. Each tool delivers complete, ready-to-use business artifacts.

tools.name: pmf_scorecard
tools.description: Assess Product-Market Fit with 5-dimension scoring (0-100), gap analysis, and 90-day action plan

tools.name: launch_commander
tools.description: Generate 12-week launch plan with RACI matrix, contingencies, and success metrics

tools.name: customer_interview_kit
tools.description: Create interview scripts, question banks, and synthesis templates

tools.name: retention_playbook
tools.description: Build health scoring models and intervention playbooks to reduce churn

tools.name: partner_architect
tools.description: Design 4-tier partner programs with economics models

tools.name: crisis_planner
tools.description: Create crisis response playbooks with severity levels

tools.name: competitive_intel
tools.description: Generate battle cards and competitive positioning maps

tools.name: craft_gtm_analyzer
tools.description: Analyze strategy documents against CRAFT principles
